cases.question: Mera phone hang ho raha hai

4. Computer/phone se printer select sahi hai?
5. Printer ko band karke 30 second baad phir chalu karo, aur ek test page print karo.
6. Agar paper jam hai to dhyaan se kagaz nikalo — zor se kheenchna mat.

cases.question: Phone ki battery jaldi khatam ho jati hai
cases.actual:

1. Screen brightness kam karo aur auto-brightness on rakho.
2. Jo apps background mein zyada battery khate hain, unhe band karo (Settings → Battery).
3. Location aur Bluetooth jab zaroorat na ho to band rakho.
4. Battery Saver mode on karo.
5. Battery bahut purani ho to badalwana padega — service centre par check karwao.

3. Photos ka backup Google Photos par lo, phir phone se delete karo.
4. Jo apps use nahi karte, unhe uninstall karo.

cases.question: UPI payment fail ho gaya, kya karu?
cases.actual:
UPI payment fail ho to:
1. Pehle check karo — paisa account se kata ya nahi (bank SMS/app mein dekho). Agar nahi kata to dobara try karo.
2. Agar paisa kat gaya par payment fail hua to 24–48 ghante mein wapas aa jata hai — bank se confirm karo.
3. Internet connection check karo aur app ko update karo.
4. UPI PIN galat to nahi — 3 baar galat PIN par UPI block ho jata hai, phir bank se reset karna padta hai.
5. Kabhi bhi kisi ko apna UPI PIN ya OTP mat batao — bank kabhi PIN/OTP nahi mangta.

cases.question: Computer slow chal raha hai

1. Computer restart karo.
2. Jo programs use nahi karte, unhe band karo — bahut sare programs ek saath khule hon to slow hota hai.
3. Temporary files saaf karo (Disk Cleanup).
4. Antivirus se ek baar scan karo.
5. Hard disk 90% se zyada bhari ho to purani files delete ya backup karo.

4. Doosra browser ya Incognito mode try karo.
5. Phir bhi na khule to ho sakta hai website hi down ho — thodi der baad try karo.

cases.question: Mujhe ek website banana hai, kaise banau?
cases.actual:
Website kaise banaye — simple plan:
1. Pehle purpose: website ko kya karna hai? (Shop ki info? Online order? Portfolio?)
2. Naam + pages: Home, Services, Prices, Contact — shuru ke liye 4 pages kaafi hain.
3. Banana: Google Sites jaisa free tool (sabse asaan) ya koi site builder; shop website ke liye coding ki zaroorat nahi.
4. Content: shop ka naam, kimmat ke saath services, phone number, address, photos.
5. Publish karo aur link WhatsApp aur Google par share karo.

Batao — kis type ki website chahiye? Shop website, personal website, ya kuch aur? Main tumhare saath step-by-step plan bana sakt

cases.question: Password bhool gaya, kya karu?
cases.actual:
Password bhool gaye ho to:
1. Login page par "Forgot Password" dabao.
2. Apna mobile number ya email likho — us par OTP/link ayega.
3. OTP se naya password banao — aasan par strong password rakho (letters + numbers).
4. Password kisi ko mat batao aur ek jagah likh kar safe rakho.
5. Agar OTP na aaye to mobile number/email sahi hai kya check karo, phir dobara try karo.

cases.question: Mera phone kho gaya, kya karu?
cases.expected: Lost phone guidance, no panic replies
cases.actual:
Phone kho gaya ho to:
1. Pehle "Find My Device" (Google) se location check karo — kisi aur phone/computer se google.com/android/find kholo.
2. Turant SIM block karwao — apne mobile company ko call karo.
3. Bank/UPI apps ka password badlo aur bank ko inform karo.
4. Police mein complaint (FIR) likhwayen — IMEI number saath le jao (box/bill par hota hai).
5. WhatsApp/email ka password bhi badlo.

5. Bill payment + mobile recharge — chhota margin par roz aane wale customer.
6. Printing + spiral binding students ke liye — exam season mein peak.

cases.question: Xerox ka rate kya rakhu?
cases.expected: Pricing advice (no invented market rate claimed as fact)

cases.question: Dukaan ke liye marketing kaise karu?

1. WhatsApp status par roz apni services aur offers dalo.
2. Dukaan ke bahar board par services + rate saaf likho.
3. Har customer ko jaate waqt apna card/number do.
4. Festival par chhota offer rakho (jaise 10 Xerox par 1 free).
5. Google par apni dukaan ka naam aur location add karo — aas-paas ke log dhoondh lenge.

cases.question: Customer se due kaise vasool karu?

1. Kaam dete waqt hi bata do — "payment 2 din mein" — pehle se clear rakho.
2. WhatsApp par polite reminder bhejo — "Bhai, aapka ₹X pending hai, kal tak de dena".
3. Customer Khata mein har customer ka due dikhta hai — wahi se list banao aur ek-ek ko call karo.
4. Bade due par naya kaam udhaar par mat do — pehle purana clear karwao.

cases.question: Shop ko online kaise le jaau?

1. Pehle Google par dukaan add karo (Google Business Profile) — free hai, log aas-paas search karke aayenge.
2. WhatsApp Business use karo — catalogue mein services aur rate dalo.
3. Ek simple website banao (Google Sites free hai) — services, rate, phone number, address.
4. Roz WhatsApp status par kaam ki photo/status dalo.

cases.question: Naya service shuru karu ya nahi?
cases.actual:
Ye raha "Shuru Karu Ya Nahi?" ka proposed plan — abhi ye bana NAHI hai, sirf proposal hai:
1. Nayi service: Shuru Karu Ya Nahi?
2. Services list aur AI Assistant mein aayegi
3. Charge / fee, Cash / UPI, Daily Business mein collection
4. Customer Khata aur Reports mein dikhegi

Agar ye plan theek hai to "Haan, banao" bolo — main ise development queue mein save kar dunga. (In-app AI khud code deploy nahi kar sakta — isiliye ye request queue mein jati hai.) Banne aur test hone ke baad hi ye app mein dikhega; usse pehle main kabhi nahi kahunga ki ye ban gaya hai.

cases.question: Dukaan ka naam kya rakhu?
cases.actual:
Dukaan ka naam rakhne ke liye:
1. Naam chhota aur yaad rakhne layak ho — 2–3 shabd se zyada na ho.
2. Kaam ka pata chale — jaise "Al Falah Communication" se pata chalta hai communication ka kaam hai.
3. Aas-paas ki dukaanon se alag ho — waisa naam mat rakho jo pehle se hai.
4. Board par bade aur saaf aksharon mein likho.

cases.question: Customer ko discount dena chahiye?
cases.actual:
Discount dene ke baare mein:
1. Har customer ko discount mat do — regular customers aur bade kaam par hi do.
2. Discount ki jagah "free add-on" behtar hai — jaise 10 Xerox par 1 free, ya lamination par chhoot.
3. Discount hamesha margin ke andar rakho — agar kaam par ₹100 bachte hain to ₹10 se zyada discount mat do.
4. Festival offer time-bound rakho — "sirf is hafte" — taaki customer jaldi aaye.

cases.question: Mera monthly budget kaise banau?
cases.actual:
Monthly Budget banane ke liye:
1. Pehle ek mahine ka kharcha likho — bijli, internet, kagaz, ink, kiraya, machine repair.
2. Income alag likho — roz ka collection Daily Business mein dikhta hai.
3. Kharcha income ka 30–40% se zyada na ho — zyada ho to sabse bada kharcha pehle kam karo.
4. Har mahine ke shuru mein ek fixed amount alag rakh lo (machine repair / emergency ke liye).

Main tumhare real kharche se budget bana sakta hoon — "Aaj ka kharcha kitna hua?" poochho, phir budget banate hain.

cases.question: Agent ko kitna commission du?
cases.actual:
Agent commission ke baare mein:
1. Commission kaam ke hisab se tay karo — chhota kaam: kam commission, bada kaam: zyada.
2. Pehle se clear rakho — customer se kitna liya, agent ko kitna dena hai, tumhara margin kitna bacha.
3. Har agent ka hisab alag rakho — BizKhata mein Agent Management mein agent-wise payable dikhta hai.
4. Payment time par do — agent time par kaam karega to customer bhi khush rahega.

cases.question: Dukaan ka kharcha kaise kam karu?
cases.actual:
Kharcha kam karne ke liye:
1. Sabse pehle ek mahine ka kharcha likho — bina likhe pata nahi chalega kahan zyada ja raha hai.
2. Kagaz aur ink thok (bulk) mein lo — per-piece sasta padta hai.
3. Machine ka time par maintenance karo — bigad jaye to repair zyada mehenga padta hai.
4. Bijli: jo machine use nahi ho rahi, use band rakho.

Main tumhare kharche ka hisab dekh kar bata sakta hoon kahan zyada ja raha hai — "Aaj ka kharcha kitna hua?" poochho.

cases.question: Mene jo dukan se dhandha kara use ye website me kha likhu batoge?

1. Daily Business page kholo — yehi jagah hai din bhar ki mixed service collection likhne ki (Xerox, Printing, PAN Card, sab ek jagah).
2. "Add Entry" dabao.
3. Service chuno (Xerox, Printing, PAN Card...), amount aur Cash/UPI likho.
4. Save dabao — entry Daily Business ke saath-saath Cash Book / UPI Book aur service report mein bhi dikhegi.
5. Sirf Cash ki entry ke liye Cash Book, sirf UPI ke liye UPI Book bhi hai — par din ka total dhandha Daily Business mein likha jata hai.

2. Today / Week / Month / Year chuno.
3. Collection, kharcha aur net earnings upar dikhenge; neeche service-wise breakdown hai.
4. CSV export bhi kar sakte ho.

cases.question: Cash Book kahan hai?

1. Cash Book page kholo (neeche button se).
2. "Add Entry" dabao.
